lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Ohio businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Ohio has no single dominant city. Columbus, Cleveland and Cincinnati are each the centre of their own region, with mid-sized cities and a great deal of manufacturing in between. We plan campaigns region by region, because what works on Lake Erie is not what works on the Ohio River.

sections.heading: The three Cs, and the cities between them
paragraphs: Columbus, in the middle of the state, is the capital and the fastest growing of the three, with state government, Ohio State University, insurance, banking, retail headquarters and a large logistics sector. Cleveland, on Lake Erie, combines a long industrial history with world-known hospital systems and a strong arts and sports culture. Cincinnati, in the southwest corner, is home to major consumer goods and grocery companies, and its metro area extends across the river into northern Kentucky.

The smaller cities have clear identities too. Dayton is tied to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and aerospace research. Toledo is known for glass and vehicle assembly, Akron for rubber and polymers, Youngstown and Canton for steel and metalworking. Each has its own media habits, suburbs and loyalties, and people in one rarely think of themselves as part of another.

sections.heading: A state that makes things
paragraphs: Manufacturing runs through the Ohio economy: cars and parts, steel, plastics, machinery, appliances, food processing. Behind every large plant is a chain of smaller suppliers, tool shops, coaters, packagers and freight companies. Most of them have relied on relationships and trade shows for sales, and many have websites that say little about what they can actually make.
For these companies, we concentrate on what an engineer or purchasing manager needs to shortlist a supplier.
bullets: Capability pages listing processes, materials, tolerances, certifications and equipment.
Search visibility for the specific part, process or service, not broad terms.
Video and photography from the shop floor.
Request-for-quote forms that are quick to complete and tracked to their source.
LinkedIn and search ads aimed at the job roles that specify and buy.

sections.heading: How Ohio households choose
paragraphs: Ohio consumers are often described as typical of the country as a whole, which is why national brands have long tested new products here. In practice that means value-conscious buyers who compare options, read reviews and prefer firms they recognise. Suburbs carry much of the spending: Dublin and Westerville around Columbus, Mason and West Chester near Cincinnati, Westlake, Solon and Mentor around Cleveland.

The seasons are distinct and they move demand. Cold winters, lake-effect snow in the northeast, spring storms and humid summers keep furnace, roofing, basement and air-conditioning firms busy in turn. Summer brings visitors to the Lake Erie shore and islands, the amusement park at Sandusky and the Hocking Hills. Autumn weekends belong to football, from high school games on Friday night to Ohio State on Saturday, and retailers, bars and restaurants plan around it.

sections.heading: Planning by region
paragraphs: A statewide campaign with one message and one budget spreads money thinly and hides what is working. We build separate campaigns for each metro you serve, with keywords, landing pages and ad copy that use local place names, and we report on each one separately so you can see where a customer costs least to win.

cards.heading: Ohio sectors we plan campaigns for

items.title: Manufacturers and suppliers
items.text: Machine shops, moulders and fabricators need sites that document capability and bring in quote requests.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Practices near the large hospital systems compete for patients with clear service pages, reviews and compliant ads.

items.title: Home services
items.text: Heating, cooling, roofing and waterproofing firms depend on map results across the suburbs.

items.title: Retail and consumer brands
items.text: Brands based in Columbus and Cincinnati need online stores, product imagery and ads managed against margin.

items.title: Logistics and distribution
items.text: Carriers and warehouse operators use their sites to win shippers and to recruit drivers and staff.

items.title: Insurance and financial services
items.text: Agencies and advisers win on search for specific needs, backed by trust signals and plain explanations.

presence: TDM works with Ohio businesses remotely. We do not have an office in the state. Calls are held by video, and plans, work in progress and reports are shared with you online.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Ohio?
faqs.a: No. Our work with Ohio businesses is done remotely, with regular video calls and written reports on an agreed schedule.

faqs.q: Should I run one campaign for all of Ohio?
faqs.a: Rarely. Columbus, Cleveland and Cincinnati differ in competitors, suburbs and ad costs. Separate campaigns let you adjust the budget for each and use the place names customers search for.

faqs.q: Can an Ohio manufacturer get leads from its website?
faqs.a: Yes. Buyers search for suppliers by process and capability. A site that states clearly what you make, to what standard and for which industries, supported by targeted search, produces quote requests. Industrial sales take time, so results are judged over months.

faqs.q: What will digital marketing cost my Ohio business?
faqs.a: That is set by scope: the channels you use, the regions you cover and the content required. We give you a quote once we have talked it through in a free consultation.
The timeline depends on your requirements and brief, and on where you are starting from. It is written into the plan we agree with you.
